ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Strong background in chemistry is highly recommended (including at least one course in organic chemistry). No class during the fall break week of (Nov. 20 - 29). Students will need a working external microphone and speakers, or a headset with microphone and high speed internet. Wireless internet is not recommended. All students will participate in the on-line lecture discussion session and complete an asynchronous module that is posted weekly.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
